added.summary: Projected decals can now override the receiver's metalness (0 to 1, default -1 keeps the receiver's metalness) and update F0 accordingly on both standard and physical surfaces.
Added glTF KHR_materials_specular dielectric specular intensity and specularColor controls on physical materials.
Added glTF KHR_materials_dispersion chromatic RGB refraction dispersion on transmissive physical materials.
